messages.subject: Virtual Work Group Tomorrow 12/4
messages.body_plain:
Hi R Users,

Welcome back from Thanksgiving break! We will be hosting our weekly work group in zoomland tomorrow, December 4th from 10-12PDT (link below). Please come with any and all of your R-related questions, or just to work and listen to some R-chat.

https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/93858202472?pwd=TGU1TU5vdFhvQW1IVVVtRDFuemUrdz09

We hope to see you all there!
The D-RUG Coo(R)dinators

--
Martha Zillig (Wohlfeil)

PhD Candidate
Avian Ecology Lab, UC Davis
Wickson Hall 3017
